item.title: Former Falcons receiver Rondale Moore found dead in Indiana
item.description: NFL receiver Rondale Moore, who spent a year on the Atlanta Falcons roster, was found dead in his Indiana hometown on Saturday. He was 25 years old. Police believe Moore died of a suspected self-inflicted gunshot wound in the garage of a property in New Albany.Floyd County Coroner Matthew Tomlin said Moore’s body will undergo an autopsy on Sunday. item.title: Weather whiplash: Gusty winds, below freezing temperatures in North Georgia
item.description: A blast of Canadian air has led to temperatures dropping drastically across North Georgia on Sunday and into Monday. The cold shock comes after several days of spring-like warmth with temperatures hitting a record 80 degrees on Friday. item.title: Second Georgia measles case of 2026 reported in Bryan County
item.description: An unvaccinated Bryan County resident has a confirmed case of measles, according to the Georgia Department of Public Health. Health officials said the person had recently traveled out of the state but did not travel internationally.Everyone who may have been exposed or is at an increased risk of catching the virus is being notified, DPH said.
